A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of Proteo-R1, including Sections 1–5, Figures 1–2, Tables 1–15, and Appendices A–D. Text, equations, tables, and relocated material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original Proteo-R1 antibody-design results in Tables 1–5 and training and ablation results in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains these original antibody-design experiments and appendix training and ablation results.

M1.justification: Sections 2–3 and Algorithms 1–3 retain the same dual-expert architecture, masked refolding, identity-plus-embedding anchoring, losses, and three-stage training procedure. The wording edits do not change the method.

E1.justification: Both versions use PDB assemblies, SAbDab antibody-antigen complexes, and the RAbD H3-only benchmark. Multi-CDR redesign, structural reasoning tasks, and Appendix D supervision examples retain the same coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 and 5 retain their respective comparator memberships, including the same MFDesign and UniMoMo comparisons. Updated citation years and newly cited related work do not introduce evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The splits, masking conditions, metrics, sampling budgets, and Appendix C training settings remain unchanged. Replacing 'peptide' with 'antibody' in the clash description corrects terminology; the metric definition and threshold are retained.

E4.justification: Oracle-anchor, modality, curriculum, sequence-validity, and Thinking/Playback analyses are retained. Table 9 removes a neither-modality row whose result cells were already empty; no reported ablation evidence is removed.

E5.justification: Table 4 retains mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, and Table 12 still averages eight responses per query. No seed information, uncertainty estimation, or significance-testing practice changes.

E6.justification: All populated result-table entries match, including RAbD RMSD 2.46 and DockQ 0.801 in Table 2 and Stage I overall accuracy 81.4% in Table 9. Reported findings are retained; the deleted empty row contains no lost scores.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, objectives, and equations are unchanged. Section 2.3 corrects the multimodal-fusion reference from Equation 3 to Equation 2, without revising either equation or its reasoning.

C1.justification: Both versions claim interpretable, modular reasoning-guided design through explicit residue anchors and improved structural/interface quality. The abstract's wording changes retain fixed-anchor commitments and do not substantively alter the contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of low native-sequence recovery, anchor accuracy as a bottleneck, backend transferability, replay benefits, and difficult CDR loops remain unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: The abstract changes 'Code, data, and demos are available' to 'Code and demos are' at the same project link, removing explicit data-availability information. This does not establish that data access was withdrawn. Technical settings, pseudocode, and supervision examples remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds citations including PoseX, Surface-VQMAE, SurfDesign, and DiffAntiSeq; the introduction and bibliography remove Goyal et al. (2026). These expand citation coverage without substantially changing research positioning. Publication updates to existing works are not new research comparisons.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized prose, terminology, cross-reference, and bibliographic corrections. It revises author order and equal-contribution information, replaces the conference-proceedings footer with a workshop-acceptance statement, and adds an acknowledgment. The scientific narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: The figure graphics remain unchanged, with minor Figure 1 caption editing and page reflow. Table 10 moves from page 22 to page 21 ahead of Table 9, Table 11 shifts to page 22, and Table 9 loses its empty neither-modality row.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves precision through the corrected fusion cross-reference, repaired Kuhlman citation, clearer antibody terminology, and removal of Table 9's empty row. Scientific evidence remains unchanged. Omitting data from the availability statement slightly weakens disclosure, but the project link and technical appendices remain; the net improvement is limited and editorial.
